title: Halberd's Cobblemon Additions
description: Adds Custom moves Abilities and Reworks to existing Moves, Items and Abilities for Cobblemon
body:
Adds or will add Custom moves and reworks/rebalances to existing moves and items for Cobblemon it does not however change the movepools of any mons

To use it make sure it's in your world's datapack folder and in your profile's resource pack folder and that it's enabled in game.
To test it enter the "/teach (you) 1 draconicaxe" command and the cobblemon in the first party slot will learn the "Draconic Axe" move if it is working

**As of current version the new descriptions of preexisting moves are not changing on the mod version so you will need an additional download of the resource pack version and set it to be at the top of the resource pack list in game to see the new discriptions**
